overview: The Upper Level of the Crafting Terraces is where master artisans refine high-quality gear and ceremonial items for Shar Vahl.
history: The terraces were carved into the sandstone cliffs overlooking Artisan Ward.
Master smiths and crafters claimed the upper level for precision work.
Heat vents and arcane stabilizers were added to manage forge output.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the terraces were expanded with new balconies.
Clan commissions for ceremonial gear became a major focus of the upper level.
hooks: A forge flare threatens nearby workbenches.
An arcane stabilizer fails during a refinement process.
A clan commission requires urgent completion.
A supply lift jam delays critical materials.
